player_prompt.intro:
Ko a yi Jokkere {player_id}. A yi kuugal 15-Puzzle.
Ko a guuren yi, a yi waɗɗa tileeji ɗin ɗemngal ɓaawo 1 haa 15, innde ɓaawo wuttudu ɓaawo ɓaawo.
A yi waɗɗa tileeji ɗin ɗemngal, a yi waɗɗa ɗum innde ɓaawo (ɓaawo __) e ɓaawo ɗaya ɗaya:
- 'up': Waɗɗa tileeji ɗin wuttudu ɓaawo ɓaawo.
- 'down': Waɗɗa tileeji ɗin ɓaawo wuttudu ɓaawo.
- 'left': Waɗɗa tileeji ɗin ɓaawo ɓaawo ɓaawo.
- 'right': Waɗɗa tileeji ɗin ɓaawo ɓaawo wuttudu.
A yi waɗɗa ɗum, a yi kuugal ɗaya (e.g., 'up', 'down', 'left', ko 'right') innde ɓaawo, e.g. [up].
Ko a yi waɗɗa ɓaawo ɓaawo ɓaawo, a yi kuugal ɗaya ɓaawo ɓaawo.

invalid_move.illegal_move: Jaɓɓol je wala kuugal. Tile footi jaɓɓa nder laawol ngol a wi'i ma.
